"""Post-inference pipeline integration: discovery, calibration and replay."""
from release import Release
from sessions import SessionEngine


def execute(request):
    """Build the certificate of one whole request."""
    capacity = request['capacity']
    releases = [Release(spec, capacity) for spec in request['releases']]
    # The derived fragment budget spans every release of the request.
    if sum(len(release.fragments) for release in releases) > 4096:
        raise ValueError('invalid_request')
    catalog = [release.catalog() for release in releases]
    engine = SessionEngine(releases, capacity)
    installs, decisions, final = engine.execute(request['blocks'])
    return {'catalog': catalog, 'installs': installs, 'decisions': decisions, 'final': final}
